  • Drag out to useDrag from the gallery into any app that takes files.

    It sorts itself.

    Smart Stacks: every image is grouped by source on arrival, and one conversation’s images stack into a single card in the gallery.

    • By sourceChatGPT, Gemini, Flow, Google AI Studio, Codex, Grok and Jimeng each get a group, shown once it has images.
    • By conversationImages from one conversation, Flow project or Codex task stack themselves. What you pull out or unstack stays that way, and named stacks keep their names.

    SHEET 07 / 12K FLOOD + 802 FLUOMCP · ASSET_SEARCH

    Your library stays on your computer.

    No account, no cloud, no sync, no uploads. Originals, Prompts and sources live in a folder you choose.

    One folder

    GravityPort Library/
├─ assets/default/
│  ├─ original/      originals
│  ├─ previews/      previews
│  └─ thumbnails/    thumbnails
├─ reference-attachments/  references
└─ database            metadata

    Deleted by mistake? You have 90 days.

    • hangzhou.png89 days left
    • bangkok-b.png61 days left
    • less-but-better.png3 days left

    Deleted images stay in Trash for 90 days, each with a countdown. Right after deleting, you can undo.

    The desktop app goes online on its own for two things only: update checks, and an anonymous activity signal at most once a day (a random install ID, version, OS and CPU architecture). Neither includes assets, Prompts, file names or paths. To turn the signal off, see the privacy policy.

    SHEET 10 / 12K FLOOD + 802 FLUOOK TO PRINT

    Install the browser extension in four steps.

    The extension sends images made on the web into GravityPort on your computer. It loads in Chrome / Chromium developer mode.

    1. 01

      Download and unzip

      Get the extension ZIP from the downloads above and unzip it into a folder you’ll keep. Don’t load it from inside the archive.

    2. 02

      Open the extensions page

      Go to chrome://extensions and turn on “Developer mode” in the top-right corner.

    3. 03

      Load the unzipped folder

      Click “Load unpacked” and choose the unzipped folder.

    4. 04

      Open GravityPort and test

      Open the desktop app, then the extension’s options; it finds GravityPort and pairs on its own. Tick the auto-capture box (“发现新图时自动入库”) and click Save (“保存设置”), then Test connection (“测试连接”); once it succeeds, you’re set.

    Picked the right folder?

    These three files should be at the top level of the folder you chose:

    • manifest.json
    • background.js
    • options.html

    If it won’t connect

    • The GravityPort desktop app is open.
    • Click “Test connection” again in the extension’s options.
    • After updating the extension, click refresh on the extensions page.
    • Still nothing? Restart GravityPort, then the browser.

    Questions

    Do I need an account?

    No. GravityPort has no accounts and no cloud.

    Will my images be sent anywhere?

    No. Your library stays on your computer. The desktop app only goes online on its own to check for updates and send an anonymous activity signal at most once a day, neither with assets, Prompts, file names or paths.

    Can I add images I already have?

    Yes, drag them into the window. GravityPort never scans your Downloads or Desktop on its own.

    Which systems are supported?

    Macs with Apple silicon, and Windows 10/11.

    How do I report a problem?

    Send it from Settings → Feedback in the app; you can attach a redacted diagnostic log and read all of it before sending. Or .
